summary: Verified TenantSwitcher visibility fix. Super Admin sees the yellow 'Set Tenant' button in bottom-left. Regular BC user in-app case could not be verified because seeded BC account (100002/bc123) is disabled at backend.

minor.issue: BC seed account payroll_number=100002/bc123 returns 'Account disabled' — blocks logged-in regular-user verification

action_items: Enable BC seed account 100002 (currently disabled) OR seed another active non-super-admin user so the negative-case (button hidden for regular user) can be fully verified in-app
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in /app/frontend/src/components/dev/TenantSwitcher.js line 65 (`if (!isDev || !isSuperAdmin) return null;`) is correct and confirmed working for Super Admin.

success_rate.frontend: Super Admin positive case verified 100%. BC negative in-app case not verifiable due to disabled account.

test_credentials: Super Admin 100001/admin123 works. BC 100002/bc123 is DISABLED at backend (Account disabled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login API expects `payroll_number` field (not `employee_number`). To fully verify TenantSwitcher hides for regular users logged-in, need an active non-super-admin account (BC 100002 is disabled).
rca of the issue: Bug: TenantSwitcher rendered for all users in dev/preview. Fix: added `!isSuperAdmin` early-return guard in TenantSwitcher.js line 65. Verified via UI: Super Admin sees the 'Set Tenant' button (data-testid='tenant-switcher-btn'); unauthenticated /login view does not render it.
